articles.summary: Kratos has successfully demonstrated end-to-end connectivity across a native, multi-vendor 5G NR NTN using Kratos’ OpenSpace®, the industry’s first fully virtualized and software-defined satellite ground system platform.
articles.title: Kratos Advances 5G NR NTN Ground System Development with Multi-Vendor Connectivity Success

articles.summary: Kratos announced major advancements in its J85 Spartan engine technology.
articles.title: Kratos Highlights Recent Successful Flight Tests of the J85 Engine Across Multiple Configurations, Including Lugged Launch, Palletized, and Surface-to-Surface Applications

articles.summary: Kratos announced multiple contract awards totaling over $100 million to develop prototype mission applications and cyber capabilities providing space intelligence data in support of joint operations across the space and cyberspace domains.
articles.title: Kratos Secures More Than $100 Million in Contracts for Space and Cyber Mission Capabilities
